title: Duran Duran
scene: British New Romantic / Birmingham new wave
influenced_by: Chic|Sex Pistols|Roxy Music|The Human League (Reproduction)|Giorgio Moroder
notes: Angular dance-punk pulse meets sequenced synths, club bass and theatrical post-punk unease.

title: Rio
notes: Elastic live rhythm section, bright synthesizers, saxophone and shadowy ballads beneath glossy pop.

title: Seven and the Ragged Tiger
notes: Densely constructed synth-funk and stadium pop alternate with jazzy saxophone and melancholy atmosphere.

title: Notorious
notes: Nile Rodgers redirects the band toward clipped funk guitar, real horns and falsetto.

title: Big Thing
scene: Late-1980s British synth-pop / emerging house crossover
notes: House-shaped electronic singles give way to hushed ballads, brass textures and uneasy introspection.

title: Liberty
notes: Restless guitar-led dance-pop, Motown echoes and glossy ballads struggle for a single direction.

title: Duran Duran (The Wedding Album)
notes: Mature guitar ballads coexist with intricate programmed grooves, sensual R&B and Brazilian inflections.

title: Thank You
notes: Cover versions reshape rap, soul and classic rock through polished guitars and lush ballads.
